EXISTS (SELECT * FROM AR_STATISTIC_EMPTYPE WHERE AR_STATISTIC_EMPTYPE.EMP_TYPE_CODE = HE.EMP_TYPE_CODE AND AR_STATISTIC_EMPTYPE.CPNY_ID = HE.CPNY_ID AND AR_STATISTIC_EMPTYPE.STAT_NO = #STAT_NO:VARCHAR#)

) TT

SELECT (CASE WHEN get_global_name(T_SCHEDULE.SCHEDULE_SHIFT_NO, 'zh') IS NOT NULL THEN get_global_name(T_SCHEDULE.SCHEDULE_SHIFT_NO, 'zh') ELSE SY2.CONTENT END) AS BANCI
FROM AR_CALENDER, (SELECT T1.SHIFT_NO SCHEDULE_SHIFT_NO, T1.AR_DATE_STR, T2.DATATYPE FROM AR_SCHEDULE_$CPNY_ID$ T1, AR_SHIFT010 T2 WHERE T1.SHIFT_NO = T2.SHIFT_NO AND T1.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#) T_SCHEDULE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY3 WHERE AR_CALENDER.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND AR_CALENDER.DDATE = to_date(T_SCHEDULE.AR_DATE_STR(+), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND AR_CALENDER.DDATE BETWEEN GET_AR_START_DATE_1(#paYear:VARCHAR#||#paMonth:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, #STAT_NO:VARCHAR#) AND GET_AR_END_DATE_1(#paYear:VARCHAR#||#paMonth:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, #STAT_NO:VARCHAR#) AND AR_CALENDER.TYPEID = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND AR_CALENDER.SHIFT_NO = SY2.NO(+) AND SY2.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' AND T_SCHEDULE.DATATYPE = SY3.NO(+) AND SY3.LANGUAGE(+) = 'zh' ORDER BY AR_CALENDER.DDATE

a.ar_date_str <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#endTime#,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'YYYY/MM/DD')

SELECT GET_HR_EMP_NAME(PERSON_ID) PERSONNAME, GET_EMP_DEPT_NAME(PERSON_ID,'zh') DEPTNAME, ITEM_NO1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ITEM_NO1 DESC) DESC1, ITEM_NO2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ITEM_NO2 DESC) DESC2, ITEM_NO3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ITEM_NO3 DESC) DESC3, ITEM_NO4, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ITEM_NO4 DESC) DESC4, ITEM_NO5, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ITEM_NO5 DESC) DESC5 FROM (SELECT PERSON_ID, EMP_TYPE_CODE, emp_office, SUM(DECODE(ITEM_NO,#ITEM1:VARCHAR#,PERSONCOUNT,0)) ITEM_NO1, SUM(DECODE(ITEM_NO,#ITEM2:VARCHAR#,PERSONCOUNT,0)) ITEM_NO2, SUM(DECODE(ITEM_NO,#ITEM3:VARCHAR#,PERSONCOUNT,0)) ITEM_NO3, SUM(DECODE(ITEM_NO,#ITEM4:VARCHAR#,PERSONCOUNT,0)) ITEM_NO4, SUM(DECODE(ITEM_NO,#ITEM5:VARCHAR#,PERSONCOUNT,0)) ITEM_NO5 FROM (SELECT COUNT(H.PERSON_ID) PERSONCOUNT, H.PERSON_ID, E.EMP_TYPE_CODE, E.emp_office, CASE WHEN H.ITEM_NO ='141442' THEN '141441' ELSE H.ITEM_NO END ITEM_NO, E.DEPTNO FROM AR_DETAIL_$CPNY_ID$ H, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE H.PERSON_ID = E.PERSON_ID AND E.LOCAL_NAME <> 'admin'
to_date(H.AR_DATE_STR, 'yyyy/mm/dd') >= to_date(#START_DATE:VARCHAR#, 'yyyy/mm/dd')

AND H.ITEM_NO IN (#ITEM1:VARCHAR#, #ITEM2:VARCHAR#, #ITEM3:VARCHAR#, #ITEM4:VARCHAR#, #ITEM5:VARCHAR#,#ITEM6:VARCHAR#) GROUP BY H.PERSON_ID, H.ITEM_NO, E.DEPTNO,E.EMP_TYPE_CODE,E.emp_office) A GROUP BY A.PERSON_ID,A.EMP_TYPE_CODE,A.emp_office) GROUP BY PERSON_ID, ITEM_NO1, ITEM_NO2, ITEM_NO3, ITEM_NO4, ITEM_NO5
